timing_scope.property: Outer prove_rtl call including final formal.json write.
timing_scope.solver_processes: Base plus induction subprocess wall, including SMTBMC/Z3 startup, encoding, I/O and shutdown; not solver CPU time.
timing_scope.validation: Pair wall minus actual C property call; includes C/A frontend, certificate and A proof plus orchestration. Per-row reporting is only in suite wall.
timing_scope.excluded: Candidate discovery, original failures, human preparation and research cover/strictness/reverse checks. No new speedup claim about those costs.

limits: Read-only evidence consistency and independent arithmetic audit, not a second solver proof or replay.
Small related fixed candidates on one host; eight repetitions do not establish general speedup or statistical significance.
Pipeline slowdown is localized to base subprocess timing; these logs do not establish its algorithmic cause.
